ModMetaData.name: The Shattered Crown
ModMetaData.author: cfrolik
ModMetaData.description:
A medieval-themed epic quest chain. The Wayfarers' Guild, a roving band of adventurers, recruits you into the hunt for the Shattered Crown: finding companions, and delving into bespoke dungeons and ruins across the rim.
Features: - A multi-part quest chain with an overarching story - Hand-crafted dungeon and ruin locations to explore - Medieval flavor: swords, bows, plate armor, and ancient secrets
Requires the Odyssey expansion (uses its structure-generation content).
